title: Include the routing dispatch byte in the maximum Announce payload
description: P2 correctness: AnnounceMessage computes MAX_ANNOUNCE_WIRE_LENGTH as 254 - link_header(4) - signer(8) - signature(48) = 194 bytes, but Node.transmit_announce wraps every Announce with the one-byte L2 routing dispatch (0x15). An Announce at the accepted maximum (93 fixed + 101 app bytes) therefore produces a 195-byte link payload and 255-byte frame body, which LinkLayer rejects above MAX_FRAME_BODY=254 after the message has already been built and signed. Subtract the routing-dispatch byte, align spec limits/vectors, and add a Node boundary test for max accepted and max+1 app data.
